description: Full detail for one post: status, targets, scheduled and published times, permalink, and the failure reason if it did not publish. Media comes back as mediaIds in slide order, not as links. Ids and profile ids are plumbing: talk to the user about accounts by handle and about posts by their caption, and do not read ids out unless they ask for one.
name: sprkly_get_post_status
title: Get post status
